<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_CreditScoring"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/credit-scoring">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ScoringRequest" name="Scoring request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DelayNotice" name="Scoring delay notice"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ScoringResult" name="Scoring result"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_CreditScoring">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_BankingSystem" name="Banking system" processRef="Process_Banking"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Agency" name="Agency" processRef="Process_Agency"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ScoringRequest" name="Scoring request" sourceRef="Task_SendRequest" targetRef="Start_AgencyRequest" messageRef="Message_ScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DelayNotice" name="Delay notice" sourceRef="Task_SendDelayNotice" targetRef="Event_CatchDelayNotice" messageRef="Message_DelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ImmediateResult" name="Immediate scoring result" sourceRef="Task_SendImmediateResult" targetRef="Event_CatchImmediateResult" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Level2Result" name="Level 2 scoring result" sourceRef="Task_SendLevel2Result" targetRef="Event_CatchLevel2Result" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Banking" name="Handle credit-scoring request" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Banking" name="Scoring requested at frontend">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Bank_Start_Send</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRequest" name="Send scoring request to agency" messageRef="Message_ScoringRequest">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Bank_Start_Send</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Bank_Send_Wait</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse" name="Wait for agency response">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Bank_Send_Wait</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Bank_Wait_Immediate</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Bank_Wait_Delay</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:eventBasedGateway>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CatchImmediateResult" name="Immediate result received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Bank_Wait_Immediate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Bank_Immediate_Display</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ImmediateResult" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CatchDelayNotice" name="Delay notice received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Bank_Wait_Delay</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Bank_Delay_DisplayNotice</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_DelayNotice" messageRef="Message_DelayNotice"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DisplayDelayNotice" name="Display message to check again later">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Bank_Delay_DisplayNotice</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Bank_DisplayNotice_WaitResult</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CatchLevel2Result" name="Scoring result received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Bank_DisplayNotice_WaitResult</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Bank_Level2_Display</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Level2Result" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DisplayImmediateResult" name="Present scoring result at frontend">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Bank_Immediate_Display</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Bank_Immediate_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DisplayLevel2Result" name="Display scoring result at frontend">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Bank_Level2_Display</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Bank_Level2_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_BankingImmediate" name="Immediate result presented">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Bank_Immediate_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_BankingLevel2" name="Level 2 result displayed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Bank_Level2_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_Start_Send" sourceRef="Start_Banking" targetRef="Task_SendRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_Send_Wait" sourceRef="Task_SendRequest" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_Wait_Immediate" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse" targetRef="Event_CatchImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_Wait_Delay" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse" targetRef="Event_CatchDelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_Immediate_Display" sourceRef="Event_CatchImmediateResult" targetRef="Task_DisplayImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_Delay_DisplayNotice" sourceRef="Event_CatchDelayNotice" targetRef="Task_DisplayDelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_DisplayNotice_WaitResult" sourceRef="Task_DisplayDelayNotice" targetRef="Event_CatchLevel2Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_Level2_Display" sourceRef="Event_CatchLevel2Result" targetRef="Task_DisplayLevel2Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_Immediate_End" sourceRef="Task_DisplayImmediateResult" targetRef="End_BankingImmediate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_Level2_End" sourceRef="Task_DisplayLevel2Result" targetRef="End_BankingLevel2"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Agency" name="Score customer" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_AgencyRequest" name="Scoring request received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Agency_Start_Level1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ScoringRequest" messageRef="Message_ScoringRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Level1Scoring" name="Perform level 1 scoring">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Agency_Start_Level1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Agency_Level1_Decision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Level1Outcome" name="Is the result immediate?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Agency_Level1_Decision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Agency_Immediate</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Agency_Delayed</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendImmediateResult" name="Send immediate scoring result" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Agency_Immediate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Agency_Immediate_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendDelayNotice" name="Inform banking system of delay" messageRef="Message_DelayNotice">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Agency_Delayed</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Agency_Delay_Level2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Level2Scoring" name="Perform level 2 scoring">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Agency_Delay_Level2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Agency_Level2_SendResult</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendLevel2Result" name="Send scoring result" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Agency_Level2_SendResult</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Agency_Level2_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AgencyOutcomeMerge" name="Continue after scoring result is sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Agency_Immediate_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Agency_Level2_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Agency_Merge_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Agency" name="Scoring response sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Agency_Merge_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_Start_Level1" sourceRef="Start_AgencyRequest" targetRef="Task_Level1Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_Level1_Decision" sourceRef="Task_Level1Scoring" targetRef="Gateway_Level1Outcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_Immediate" name="Result determined immediately" sourceRef="Gateway_Level1Outcome" targetRef="Task_SendImmediateResult">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The result is determined immediately</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_Delayed" name="Result cannot be determined immediately" sourceRef="Gateway_Level1Outcome" targetRef="Task_SendDelayNotice">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The result cannot be determined immediately</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_Immediate_Merge" sourceRef="Task_SendImmediateResult" targetRef="Gateway_AgencyOutcomeMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_Delay_Level2" sourceRef="Task_SendDelayNotice" targetRef="Task_Level2Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_Level2_SendResult" sourceRef="Task_Level2Scoring" targetRef="Task_SendLevel2Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_Level2_Merge" sourceRef="Task_SendLevel2Result" targetRef="Gateway_AgencyOutcomeMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_Merge_End" sourceRef="Gateway_AgencyOutcomeMerge" targetRef="End_Agency"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_CreditScoring"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/credit-scoring">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ScoringRequest" name="Scoring request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DelayNotice" name="Scoring delay notice"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ScoringResult" name="Scoring result"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_CreditScoring">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_BankingSystem" name="Banking system" processRef="Process_Banking"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Agency" name="Agency" processRef="Process_Agency"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ScoringRequest" name="Scoring request"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendRequest" targetRef="Start_AgencyRequest"
                      messageRef="Message_ScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DelayNotice" name="Delay notice"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendDelayNotice" targetRef="Event_CatchDelayNotice"
                      messageRef="Message_DelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ImmediateResult" name="Immediate scoring result"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendImmediateResult" targetRef="Event_CatchImmediateResult"
                      messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Level2Result" name="Level 2 scoring result"
                      sourceRef="Task_SendLevel2Result" targetRef="Event_CatchLevel2Result"
                      messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Banking" name="Handle credit-scoring request" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Banking" name="Scoring requested via frontend">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Bank_Start_Send</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRequest" name="Send scoring request to agency" messageRef="Message_ScoringRequest">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Bank_Start_Send</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Bank_Send_Wait</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse" name="Wait for agency response">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Bank_Send_Wait</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Bank_Wait_Immediate</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Bank_Wait_Delay</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:eventBasedGateway>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CatchImmediateResult" name="Immediate scoring result received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Bank_Wait_Immediate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Bank_Immediate_Display</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ImmediateResult" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CatchDelayNotice" name="Delay notice received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Bank_Wait_Delay</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Bank_Delay_DisplayNotice</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_DelayNotice" messageRef="Message_DelayNotice"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DisplayDelayNotice" name="Display message to check again later">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Bank_Delay_DisplayNotice</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Bank_DisplayNotice_WaitResult</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CatchLevel2Result" name="Level 2 scoring result received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Bank_DisplayNotice_WaitResult</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Bank_Level2_Display</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Level2Result" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DisplayImmediateResult" name="Present scoring result at frontend">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Bank_Immediate_Display</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Bank_Immediate_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DisplayLevel2Result" name="Display scoring result at frontend">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Bank_Level2_Display</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Bank_Level2_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_BankingImmediate" name="Immediate result presented">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Bank_Immediate_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_BankingLevel2" name="Level 2 result displayed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Bank_Level2_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_Start_Send" sourceRef="Start_Banking" targetRef="Task_SendRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_Send_Wait" sourceRef="Task_SendRequest" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_Wait_Immediate" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse" targetRef="Event_CatchImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_Wait_Delay" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse" targetRef="Event_CatchDelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_Immediate_Display" sourceRef="Event_CatchImmediateResult" targetRef="Task_DisplayImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_Delay_DisplayNotice" sourceRef="Event_CatchDelayNotice" targetRef="Task_DisplayDelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_DisplayNotice_WaitResult" sourceRef="Task_DisplayDelayNotice" targetRef="Event_CatchLevel2Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_Level2_Display" sourceRef="Event_CatchLevel2Result" targetRef="Task_DisplayLevel2Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_Immediate_End" sourceRef="Task_DisplayImmediateResult" targetRef="End_BankingImmediate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_Level2_End" sourceRef="Task_DisplayLevel2Result" targetRef="End_BankingLevel2"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Agency" name="Score customer" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_AgencyRequest" name="Scoring request received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Agency_Start_Level1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ScoringRequest" messageRef="Message_ScoringRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Level1Scoring" name="Perform level 1 quick scoring">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Agency_Start_Level1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Agency_Level1_Decision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Level1Outcome" name="Can the result be determined immediately?" default="Flow_Agency_Delayed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Agency_Level1_Decision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Agency_Immediate</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Agency_Delayed</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendImmediateResult" name="Send immediate scoring result" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Agency_Immediate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Agency_Immediate_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendDelayNotice" name="Inform banking system of delay" messageRef="Message_DelayNotice">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Agency_Delayed</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Agency_Delay_Level2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Level2Scoring" name="Perform level 2 scoring">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Agency_Delay_Level2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Agency_Level2_SendResult</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendLevel2Result" name="Send scoring result after level 2">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Agency_Level2_SendResult</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Agency_Level2_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_AgencyImmediate" name="Immediate scoring result sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Agency_Immediate_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_AgencyLevel2" name="Level 2 scoring result sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Agency_Level2_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_Start_Level1" sourceRef="Start_AgencyRequest" targetRef="Task_Level1Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_Level1_Decision" sourceRef="Task_Level1Scoring" targetRef="Gateway_Level1Outcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_Immediate" name="Result determined immediately" sourceRef="Gateway_Level1Outcome" targetRef="Task_SendImmediateResult">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">resultDeterminedImmediately</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_Delayed" name="Result cannot be determined immediately" sourceRef="Gateway_Level1Outcome" targetRef="Task_SendDelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_Immediate_End" sourceRef="Task_SendImmediateResult" targetRef="End_AgencyImmediate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_Delay_Level2" sourceRef="Task_SendDelayNotice" targetRef="Task_Level2Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_Level2_SendResult" sourceRef="Task_Level2Scoring" targetRef="Task_SendLevel2Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_Level2_End" sourceRef="Task_SendLevel2Result" targetRef="End_AgencyLevel2"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
